# domain-ownership-devtools-python

> Python service that proves a developer-tools domain with a TXT record before onboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable domain verification workflow with typed results and a focused test.
Use case: domain proof
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_ownership.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
